story.headline:
Small batch.
Big flavor.
story.accentText: From the shores of Lake Erie
story.statement: We started with one idea: make snacks you can actually feel good about.
paragraphs: No mystery ingredients. No corporate shortcuts. Just real fruit, dried with care in Western New York.
We source from orchards that have been growing incredible apples for generations — and we keep things simple on purpose.

testimonials.quote: These are the best dried apple snacks I've ever had. You can taste the difference real ingredients make.
testimonials.author: Sarah M.

testimonials.quote: My kids ask for these every day after school. So glad I found a snack I feel good about giving them.
testimonials.author: Mike R.

testimonials.quote: The cinnamon maple flavor is incredible. I keep a bag in my desk at work — they never last long.
testimonials.author: Jennifer L.

testimonials.quote: Finally, a snack company that actually cares about what goes into their products. Three ingredients. That's it.
testimonials.author: David K.
